name: @velaros-ai/knowledge
description: Workspace knowledge index for VelarOS-compatible runtimes: incremental ingestion of documents and code, chunking, SQLite full-text plus vector hybrid retrieval with embedding profile isolation, diagnostics and explicit rebuild, and the knowledge agent tools.
author: VelarOS

scripts.build: bun run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/capabilities/build/fix-esm-extensions.mjs dist && node ../../scripts/build/normalize-package-declarations.mjs
scripts.test: bun run build && node --test test/injected-boundaries.test.mjs test/package-consumer.test.mjs && bun test spec/acceptance.test.ts test/code-helper-imports.test.ts test/ingestion-data-lifecycle.test.ts test/knowledgeSearchFailOpen.test.ts test/EmbeddingProfileIsolation.test.ts test/standaloneModuleImport.test.ts
